changelog: Security: the shared admin/admin123 default is gone. First run now generates a password unique to the installation, prints it once to the service log, and writes it to /opt/urbackup-gui/initial-admin-password.txt at mode 0600. The installer shows it when it finishes.

Security: removed the unauthenticated /api/setup/status endpoint, which reported whether the default password was still in use — and with it the login page banner that printed the username and password to any anonymous visitor.
The forced password change is now driven by a must_change_password flag returned only to the authenticated account it applies to, instead of the client guessing from the password it just typed.
Upgrades: on first start after updating, any account still using the old admin123 default is flagged and must change its password at next login.
